newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell says wins Thai support on BERTS.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell says wins Thai support on BERTS.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that the Thai government had decided to provide support to the company's Bangkok Elevated Rail Train System (BERTS) project.
"Hopewell is pleased to see this concrete support from the Thai Government and we look forward to working with them to complete this project," Hopewell chairman Gordon Wu said.
"Of course there are many more steps to go in this process and we are awaiting more details from the government, but we are on the way," he said in a statement.

Hopewell said the Thai government had reviewed and approved the company's submissions which were pre-requisites to the completion of the project, including government support for financing, but added it was expecting details later.
The decision would help clear the major concerns of potential lenders to the project and allow the financing arrangements with banks to move ahead, it said.
The much delayed BERTS project includes a toll road and a community train system as well as retail developments.
